question: Murlikant Rajaram Petkar of Maharashtra was awarded with Arjuna Award 2024 in which of the following fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Para-Swimming**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Murlikant Rajaram Petkar** is a renowned Indian para-athlete and the first Indian to win a gold medal at the **Paralympics Games**.
 
• He achieved this milestone in **1972 Munich Paralympics** in the sport of Para-Swimming, clocking a world record time of 37.33 seconds in the 50m freestyle swimming event.
 
• Petkar hails from Maharashtra and was initially a soldier in the Indian Army. He suffered severe injuries during the **1965 India-Pakistan war**, leading to his disability.
